Board posts left: 0. Notes allowed: 1 per resident, none possible to Corvin or Sable.

Is there anything to do? No stall, no blocker. All residents acted at minute 19, level 5 since 18-19. Nothing stalled. So silence is the right choice. Answer with one short sentence.

Actually, could the whisperer need help? He's met his orders. Fine.

So no intervention.
No door is stalled, no blocker is named, every resident acted at minute 19 and fifteen open points are still in play — nothing I could say would change what happens next.
